# Matías Rodríguez

> AI Engineer and Tech Lead based in Argentina. I design and build AI-powered systems — from conversational agents to full SaaS platforms. 7+ years backend, 4+ years AI/LLM.

## About

I work in Python, Go, and TypeScript, with experience leading technical teams and delivering products end to end. Available for remote roles, freelance projects, and AI/backend consulting.

## Skills

- **AI & LLMs**: Multi-agent systems, RAG pipelines, chatbots with human handoff, automated quality evaluation
- **Backend**: REST and gRPC APIs in Python/Go, multi-tenant architectures, microservices, authentication
- **Cloud**: AWS, GCP, Docker, CI/CD, Firebase
- **Frontend**: Next.js, React, TypeScript

## Projects

### Guest Experience Automation
AI-powered guest experience platform for boutique hotels. Automated check-in, concierge recommendations, and review generation using LLMs. Reduced manual workload by 70%.

### WhatsApp Chatbots
End-to-end WhatsApp automation for SMBs. Multi-turn conversations, CRM integration, and human handoff. Built for scale with multi-tenant architecture.

### Trading Tools
Algorithmic trading infrastructure for retail traders. Backtesting engine, real-time signal alerts, and portfolio analytics dashboard.

### Web Projects
Full-stack web apps for small businesses and coaches. Next.js frontends with Firebase backends. Live examples: efigueiras-coach.web.app, mvp-quiadsa.web.app.
